name: Automatic CFG (per-channel range normalization)
plain: Sets a separate cfg for each latent channel so the guided output reaches a target intensity based on top-k value range. Also has a large set of extras: skip or fake uncond, experimental functions, attention modifiers, latent centring. It also replaces core's sampling function.
math:
R = (mean of top-k max + mean of top-k min-based)/2 per channel of a reference CFG (measure hard, soft, hard_squared, range)
d = reference_cfg·(reference last cfg/10)/R_c
f_c = u_c + d_c·(c_c−u_c)
Optional: u ← lerp(c,u,w)·‖u‖/‖lerp‖; fake uncond x̂_u = x̂_c·k; return only cond in skipped window.

props.extra_model_calls: ≤1; optionally skips or fakes uncond in sigma windows
props.params: automatic_cfg=hard, skip_uncond, fake_uncond_*, uncond_sigma_start/end, lerp_uncond, cond_exp_*, uncond_exp_*, auto_cfg_ref, top_k, subtract_latent_mean, latent_intensity_rescale, attention modifiers...

providers.author: AbstractEyes
providers.note: Only the basic per-channel range rule (reference_scale 8, top_k 0.25, mode hard|soft|hard_squared|range), x0 space; none of the original pack's uncond tricks or skip windows.

label: from code
surprise: It monkey-patches comfy.samplers.sampling_function; the pre-CFG slot it adds is not a core hook, so it may conflict with other sampling patches.
